title: Observed assistant turn (observable-only)
description: One record per emitted assistant turn, including final answers and failed or missing plans. No record is fabricated for a request that produced no assistant message. Attack metadata and outcomes live only in data/meta/.

episode_id.description: Opaque episode id; must not encode the attack name or injection task.

turn_index.description: Zero-based assistant turn index within the episode.

message_index.description: Index of this assistant message in the run's raw_trace.jsonl.

plan_raw.description: Exact tagged plan block on success; entire assistant text on failure.

parse_error.description: Parser error code on failure; null on success. Never an API exception or outcome.

is_commit.description: True only for a successfully parsed first or changed plan.

commit_index.description: Corresponding event's episode-local commit index, or null for a non-commit turn.
